title: Halting time of the amplified machine
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic machine, let $r$ be a natural number, let $\mathrm{dec}:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. If $N$ halts on $x$ after every choice word of length exactly $T$, then the amplified machine with parameters $r$ and $\mathrm{dec}$ halts on $x$ after every choice word of length exactly $T+r(T+|x|+2)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: The original machine halts on input $x$ for every choice word of length exactly $T$
